SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a responsibility? (1 mark)
   A. A duty you should do
   B. A gift
   C. A secret
   D. A toy

2. Which of these is a benefit of economic activities? (1 mark)
   A. They stop trade
   B. They make people poor
   C. They close schools
   D. They give people jobs and income

3. In many parts of Kenya, when do the long rains usually come? (1 mark)
   A. March to May
   B. January to February
   C. June to August
   D. September only

4. A group spent Ksh 400 and earned Ksh 700. What is the profit? (1 mark)
   A. Ksh 700
   B. Ksh 400
   C. Ksh 1,100
   D. Ksh 300

5. Which direction is Mombasa from Nairobi on a map of Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. North
   B. South-east
   C. North-west
   D. West

6. Why does Kenya not have summer and winter like countries far from the equator? (1 mark)
   A. Kenya is too small
   B. Kenya lies on the equator so temperatures change little
   C. Kenya has no rain
   D. Kenya has no sun

7. What is one benefit of interdependence? (1 mark)
   A. We become poor
   B. We stop working
   C. We get goods and services we cannot make ourselves
   D. We stop trading

8. What is the meaning of composition of a group? (1 mark)
   A. The people or parts that make up the group
   B. The size of the room
   C. The colour of the group
   D. The song of the group

9. Who can be a role model? (1 mark)
   A. A teacher or an elder
   B. Nobody
   C. Only a rich person
   D. Only a president

10. Gede Ruins are near which coastal town? (1 mark)
   A. Watamu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nyeri

11. Reduce, reuse and recycle are ways of doing what? (1 mark)
   A. Growing tea
   B. Cutting down waste
   C. Building roads
   D. Drying fish

12. Which day is the International Day of Peace? (1 mark)
   A. 1 January
   B. 25 December
   C. 21 September
   D. 12 December

13. What is a citizen? (1 mark)
   A. A type of school
   B. A member of a country or community with rights and duties
   C. A kind of law
   D. A visitor who never returns

14. Why are sugar factories usually built near cane farms? (1 mark)
   A. Farmers do not like factories
   B. Cane is hard to find
   C. Cane is heavy and costly to carry far
   D. Sugar cannot be sold

15. What is a neighbouring county? (1 mark)
   A. A county in another country
   B. A county with the same name
   C. A county that shares a boundary with your county
   D. The biggest county

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain how tourism can benefit a county and its people. (5 marks)

17. Explain what a Children's Government is. (2 marks)

18. State three roles of an MCA. (3 marks)

19. Explain three effects of child abuse on a child. (3 marks)

20. What is a sub-county? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — A duty you should do
   Rights come with responsibilities.

2. D — They give people jobs and income
   Economic activities provide income and food.

3. A — March to May
   The long rains are usually from March to May.

4. D — Ksh 300
   700 - 400 = 300.

5. B — South-east
   Mombasa lies to the south-east of Nairobi.

6. B — Kenya lies on the equator so temperatures change little
   Near the equator the temperature stays fairly steady, so rain and altitude decide our seasons.

7. C — We get goods and services we cannot make ourselves
   Sharing skills gives us more goods and services.

8. A — The people or parts that make up the group
   Composition means the members that make up a group.

9. A — A teacher or an elder
   Ordinary people can be good role models.

10. A — Watamu
   Gede Ruins are near Watamu in Kilifi County.

11. B — Cutting down waste
   The three Rs cut down waste.

12. C — 21 September
   The International Day of Peace is on 21 September.

13. B — A member of a country or community with rights and duties
   Citizens belong to a community and have rights and duties.

14. C — Cane is heavy and costly to carry far
   Being near saves transport costs.

15. C — A county that shares a boundary with your county
   Neighbouring counties touch each other along a boundary.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: Visitors pay park and hotel fees. Guides and drivers get jobs. Hotels and shops earn money. Local crafts are sold. The county earns taxes to build roads and clinics.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a group of pupils elected by their classmates to help run the school and speak for pupils, guided by a teacher.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for elected pupils, 1 mark for helping and speaking for pupils.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Represent the ward, make county laws, and approve the budget. Accept checking the governor.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each role.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Pain and illness, fear and sadness, and missing school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each effect.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A sub-county is a smaller part of a county. Each county is divided into sub-counties.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying it is a smaller part, 1 mark for the link with a county.
